// _comment: AletCloud App Hosting config for DBPCMS. If AletCloud's dashboard asks you to type the build/start commands manually instead of reading this file, copy the values from here. See docs/DEPLOY-ALETCLOUD.md for the full walkthrough.
name: dbpcms
// build: Installs deps with the exact pnpm version and builds shared + web + api, copying the frontend into the API so ONE app serves everything.
buildCommand: corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build:prod
// start: Waits for the database to be reachable, runs migrations, seeds baseline data (idempotent), then starts the API.
// port: The app reads process.env.PORT. AletCloud injects it; do not hardcode.

envVars.value: <PASTE the AletCloud Managed Database connection string here>
<PASTE your AletCloud app URL here, e.g. https://dbpcms.aletcloud.app>
<generate a DIFFERENT long random 32+ char secret>
